Toyota Camry Reliability and Ownership The Camry's reputation for reliability is not marketing spin — it's decades of documented owner experience. As long as the service history checks out and a pre-purchase inspection comes back clean, mileage like this should not be a dealbreaker.
What does the Camry SE trim include over the base LE? The SE trim adds sport-tuned suspension, a blacked-out grille and exterior accents, sportier 18-inch wheels, a leather-wrapped steering wheel and shifter, SofTex sport seating, and a more aggressive overall look. It also typically includes push-button start and additional safety tech as standard. It's the choice for buyers who want a Camry that drives and looks a little sharper.

It does not include Android Auto as a factory feature, but many buyers use Bluetooth for Android device connectivity.
Is the 8-speed automatic in the 2019 Camry reliable? Yes. Toyota's 8-speed direct-shift automatic is generally well-regarded for smoothness and durability. At highway speeds it keeps engine RPMs low for better fuel economy, and its sequential shift mode allows manual gear selection for a more engaged driving feel. Here is the complete description:2012 Mazda Mazda5 Sport FWD - White - 6-Speed Manual - Stock 100240P - Only $6,995If you have been searching for a fun-to-drive, six-passenger compact minivan that delivers real-world practicality without the minivan price tag, this 2012 Mazda Mazda5 Sport in White is exactly what you have been looking for. Priced at just $6,995, this uniquely capable and surprisingly sporty family hauler is one of the most versatile used vehicles available at any price point.A RARE FIND: THE ONLY MINIVAN WITH A MANUAL TRANSMISSIONOne of the most distinctive features of this 2012 Mazda5 Sport is its exclusive 6-speed manual transmission, a configuration that sets this vehicle apart from virtually every other family-oriented vehicle on the market. The Mazda5 Sport was the only minivan-style vehicle available with a manual gearbox, and driving enthusiasts who also happen to need family-friendly versatility have long celebrated this vehicle for exactly that reason. Paired with the responsive 2.5-liter DOHC 16-valve four-cylinder engine producing 157 horsepower and 163 lb-ft of torque, this combination delivers an engaging, driver-focused experience that no other compact van can match. Front-wheel drive rounds out the powertrain for confident, predictable handling in everyday conditions.OUTSTANDING FUEL ECONOMY FOR A SIX-PASSENGER VEHICLEWith EPA-estimated fuel economy of 21 MPG city and 28 MPG highway, the 2012 Mazda5 Sport punches well above its weight class in efficiency. This makes it one of the most fuel-friendly six-seat vehicles available anywhere near this price range, saving families real money at the pump compared to larger crossovers and full-size minivans.SIX-PASSENGER VERSATILITY IN A COMPACT, EASY-TO-PARK PACKAGEThe Mazda5 delivers full three-row, six-passenger seating in a compact footprint that is dramatically easier to maneuver and park than traditional minivans. The second row features two individual captain's chairs with armrests and convenient hidden storage compartments beneath the seat cushions, providing easy access to the third row. The 50/50 split-folding third-row seat expands cargo capacity significantly, offering up to 44.4 cubic feet of space with the third row folded, or a maximum of 89.3 cubic feet with both rear rows down for hauling larger loads. Sliding rear doors make loading and unloading passengers, car seats, and cargo effortlessly safe, eliminating the door-swinging hazards of conventional vehicles in tight parking situations. The cabin features numerous thoughtfully designed storage cubbies and compartments throughout, keeping families organized on every trip.WELL-EQUIPPED SPORT TRIM STANDARD FEATURESDespite its accessible price point, the Mazda5 Sport trim comes genuinely well-equipped from the factory. Standard features include automatic dual-zone climate control with rear vents and fan controls, a six-speaker AM/FM/CD/MP3 audio system with auxiliary audio input, full power accessories including windows, door locks and mirrors, keyless entry, cruise control with steering-wheel-mounted controls, a tilt-and-telescoping steering wheel, a height-adjustable driver seat, and a one-touch power driver window. The Mazda5 also features a deep, spacious glove box with a molded upper ledge for devices and a center console cubby perfectly sized for phones and accessories.SAFETY BUILT INTO EVERY MILEThe 2012 Mazda5 Sport was engineered with comprehensive safety technology throughout. Standard safety equipment includes all-disc anti-lock brakes with brake assist and electronic brake-force distribution, electronic stability control, traction control, and a total of six airbags including side-curtain airbags extending protection across all three rows of passengers. A Brake Override System reduces engine power when the accelerator and brake are simultaneously engaged, and non-crushable brake and accelerator pedals provide added protection in a frontal collision.SPORTY EXTERIOR STYLINGThe clean White exterior reflects Mazda's Nagare flow design philosophy, giving the Mazda5 a dynamic, forward-leaning stance that looks nothing like a conventional minivan. The Sport trim rides on 16-inch alloy wheels and features a black front grille insert that adds a sporty edge to the overall appearance. At just over 180 inches in length, the Mazda5 is sized right for urban commuting and suburban family life alike.THE SMART CHOICE FOR BUDGET-CONSCIOUS FAMILIESUsed six-passenger vehicles with real cargo flexibility, sliding doors, three-row seating, and proven reliability are rarely found at this price. The 2012 Mazda Mazda5 Sport is a uniquely compelling option for growing families, rideshare drivers, small business owners, or anyone who needs to move people and cargo efficiently without spending a fortune. At $6,995, this vehicle represents an outstanding value that is difficult to replicate elsewhere in the used car market.Do not let this one slip away. description: Discover the 2024 Nissan Sentra SV, a sleek and efficient sedan that combines modern technology with confident performance. Designed for drivers who value style and practicality, this used Sentra offers an impressive fuel economy of up to 40 mpg highway and 30 mpg city, making it an ideal choice for daily commuting and weekend getaways. Its lightweight body and 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine deliver a spirited 149 horsepower at 6,000 rpm and 146 lb-ft of torque at 4,000 rpm, ensuring responsive acceleration and smooth handling. The Sentra SV comes equipped with advanced safety features such as adaptive cruise control, blind spot monitor, collision warning, and a backup camera, providing peace of mind on every journey. Inside, you'll enjoy the convenience of keyless entry, push start, Bluetooth connectivity, Apple CarPlay, and SiriusXM satellite radio, all accessible through an intuitive 8-inch touchscreen infotainment system. With seating for five and four doors, this sedan combines comfort and versatility, making it perfect for families and urban adventurers alike. The 2024 Nissan Sentra Safety and Security Features The Sentra SV is built with safety at its core, featuring automatic emergency braking with rear detection to prevent collisions. It includes a rear check rear seat reminder to ensure no one is left behind, dual front knee airbags for enhanced protection, and traffic sign recognition to keep you aware of road regulations. Parking is made easier with rear parking sensors, while the anti-lock braking system (ABS) and cornering brake control improve stability during abrupt stops or sharp turns. The vehicle also offers auto-locking power door locks and anti-lockout functionality, along with comprehensive security to safeguard you and your passengers at all times. The 2024 Nissan Sentra Entertainment and Technology Features Technology is seamlessly integrated into the Sentra SV to enhance every drive. The vehicle offers voice-operated hands-free phone call integration, allowing you to stay connected without distraction. Its radio system is also voice-activated, complemented by an 8-inch touch screen display that provides quick access to entertainment options. The infotainment system boasts six speakers for rich sound quality and supports auxiliary audio inputs via USB and iPod/iPhone connections. Electronic messaging assistance, both read and voice-operated, keeps you connected safely while on the move, making this sedan as smart as it is stylish. The 2024 Nissan Sentra Performance Features Under the hood, the Sentra SV features auto start/stop technology, which intelligently manages engine operation to improve fuel efficiency and reduce emissions. This feature enhances the overall driving experience by conserving fuel during idling periods, making it an eco-friendly choice without sacrificing performance. The combination of advanced start-stop functionality, efficient engine design, and front-wheel drive ensures a smooth, responsive ride that adapts well to city streets and highways alike. With its balanced performance and economical operation, the Sentra SV stands out as a practical yet engaging sedan for everyday driving.
